description: This test verifies that users can browse products by selecting a category from the navigation menu and that the appropriate product listing page is displayed.
steps: Click on the 'Men' category link in the navigation menu.
Wait for the product listing page for the 'Men' category to load.
Verify that the URL matches the expected URL for the 'Men' category.
Assert that the product listing contains items exclusively from the 'Men' category.
Repeat the above steps for 'Women' and 'Accessories' categories.
Verify that each category displays the correct set of products.
expected_results: The correct product listing page for the selected category is displayed.
The URL matches the expected URL for the selected category.
Only products belonging to the selected category are displayed.
edge_cases: The product listing page fails to load.
The product listing displays items from other categories.
The URL does not change after clicking the category link.
Page navigation takes an unusually long time.
data_requirements: Test data for products categorized under 'Men'.
Test data for products categorized under 'Women'.
Test data for products categorized under 'Accessories'.
The navigation menu must be visible and clickable.
Proper labels for all category links.
dependencies: The Store page is functional and accessible.
Categories have products associated with them.
The navigation menu is implemented correctly.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch products for the selected category.
performance_metrics: Page load time for product category pages.
accessibility_requirements: Category links must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Proper ARIA roles and labels for navigation menu links.
Sufficient color contrast for text in the navigation menu.
